description: This file defines a React component named CompanyAvatar that renders a company logo or initial as an avatar, used within a React application with Material UI and react-admin. It imports React, Material UI's Avatar component, and react-admin's useRecordContext hook. The component displays the company's logo if available, otherwise the first character of the company name.

methods.name: CompanyAvatar
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a company's avatar based on provided record data and optional size props.
